items.issue: Each checkpoint needed an explicit engineering-decision review alongside runnable code.

items.issue: Write-error poisoning and stale compaction were documented but lacked direct regressions.

items.issue: Check professional resource and lifecycle habits at first implementation.
items.fix: Already complies: bounded admission/queues/buffers; narrow receiver lock; per-file failures; deterministic presentation; request-wide and endpoint deadlines; bounded retries; owned task set aborted and drained at shutdown. Documented cooperative cancellation and limited HTTP transport scope.

items.issue: Check unsafe-first teaching and unsupported claims.
items.fix: Already complies: safe baseline precedes custom unsafe representation; private initialized-prefix invariant and local safety comments; bounds, ownership, ZST/alignment/drop/panic tests; Miri explicitly additional evidence and independent review pending.

items.issue: Intentional failures must be clearly labeled and match compiler diagnostics.
items.fix: All 4 compile-fail examples verified under mise; E0502/E0277/E0373/E0133 observed as expected.

items.issue: Public mutable replay metrics let API callers bypass validated accounting transitions.
items.fix: Made accounting fields private, exposed read-only getter methods, and updated CLI plus engineering explanations. Test-only internal overflow injection remains available inside the module.
